name: nad-plugins
description: NAD Plugin Devkit, first-party plugin workbench, and release tooling.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter './plugins/official/*' check && pnpm --filter @nad/example-proxmox-v2 check && pnpm --filter @nad/example-proxmox-guest-controls check
scripts.pack:official: node devkit/packages/cli/dist/index.js pack plugins/official/network --out dist --require-signature --release-record && node devkit/packages/cli/dist/index.js pack plugins/official/proxmox --out dist --require-signature --release-record && node devkit/packages/cli/dist/index.js pack plugins/official/unraid --out dist --require-signature --release-record
scripts.preview:system-monitor: node devkit/packages/cli/dist/index.js dev plugins/official/system-monitor --once --role viewer --endpoint summary
